coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: pass the recipient's availability to dispatch, get a confirmed replacement booking and the recipient's acknowledgement.

recipient.name: Fenn Azel

dispatch.name: Dispatch
dispatch.responsibility: Schedule and reserve the replacement delivery attempt and state any charge.

goal: Get dispatch's confirmation of a replacement booking for DL-012 and the recipient's acknowledgement of the revised plan.
limits: Do not treat the customer's acknowledgement as a delivery; it closes the rebooking only.
Do not erase either conflicting record or infer a finding before the owner supplies evidence.
